recipe_name: Halloumi Mango Chutney Curry
cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 2 garlic cloves. Slice the onion, trim green beans, grate garlic and cube halloumi. Cook 150 g basmati rice in 300 ml water: bring to a boil, cover on low for 10 minutes, then rest covered off heat for 10 minutes. Fry green beans for 3-4 minutes until beginning to soften and set aside. Fry halloumi until golden on all sides, about 4-5 minutes, then remove. Soften onion in the same pan for 5 minutes; add garlic, curry powder and tomato puree and stir for 1 minute. Add passata and 100 ml water; simmer 5 minutes. Return beans and halloumi, add most of the mango chutney and simmer 5-6 minutes. Mix remaining chutney into yoghurt and serve with curry and rice.

recipe_name: Halloumi Sweetcorn Chipotle Tacos
cooking_instructions: Prepare 30 g spring onions (about 2 spring onions). Heat oven to 180 C. Thinly slice onion, dice green pepper and halloumi, drain sweetcorn and slice spring onion. Heat a large frying pan with a splash of water and stir-fry pepper and sweetcorn for 4-5 minutes until softened and lightly coloured. Add onion and cook for 3-4 minutes more. Mix chipotle paste with mayonnaise in a bowl. Transfer vegetables to a plate; fry halloumi in the same pan for 5-6 minutes, turning until golden on all sides. Warm tortillas in oven for 2-3 minutes. Spread with chipotle mayonnaise, add vegetables and halloumi, then scatter over spring onion.

recipe_name: Halloumi Burger with Chickpea Mango Salad
cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 0.5 lettuce. Halve burger buns and cut halloumi into thick slices. Toast buns cut-side down in a hot dry pan for about 1 minute and set aside. Fry halloumi for 2 minutes per side until golden. Separate lettuce leaves, reserving four for the burgers; shred the rest. Slice half the tomatoes for burgers and dice the remainder. Chop mint, zest and juice lime, and drain chickpeas. Mix yoghurt with mint and lime zest; spread a little onto buns. Toss remaining yoghurt with chickpeas, shredded lettuce, diced tomato, lime juice and half the mango chutney. Coat warm halloumi in remaining chutney. Assemble buns with reserved lettuce, tomato slices and halloumi; serve chickpea salad alongside.

recipe_name: Creamy Mushroom and Spinach Gnocchi
cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 2 garlic cloves. Heat oven to 130 C to keep cooked gnocchi warm if needed. Grate garlic and slice mushrooms. Heat vegetable oil in a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat; fry gnocchi for 8-10 minutes, turning until golden and crisp, then transfer to a warm plate. Add mushrooms to the pan and fry for 6-8 minutes until browned. Lower heat and stir in garlic for 1 minute. Add creme fraiche and about 150 ml water; stir and simmer for 1-2 minutes. Add spinach by handfuls and cook 2-3 minutes until wilted. Return gnocchi briefly to coat in sauce, then serve topped with grated hard cheese.

recipe_name: Smoky Chorizo and Pea Orzo
cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 2 garlic cloves. Boil orzo in salted water for about 10 minutes or according to packet instructions, then drain, reserving a little cooking water. Meanwhile fry diced chorizo in a dry large frying pan over medium-high heat for 3-4 minutes until coloured. Add grated garlic, smoked paprika and tomato puree and stir for 1 minute. Stir in creme fraiche and 150 ml water and simmer gently for 3-4 minutes. Add peas and cook until piping hot, about 2-3 minutes. Stir in grated hard cheese and cooked orzo, adding reserved cooking water if too thick. Divide between bowls.

recipe_name: Prawn Asparagus Risotto
cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 2 garlic cloves. Thinly slice leek, grate garlic, trim asparagus and chop parsley. Dissolve vegetable stock cube in 750 ml hot water and keep warm. Soften leek in a wide pan with a little water for 5-6 minutes; add garlic and cook for 1 minute. Stir in arborio rice for 1 minute. Add stock a ladle at a time, stirring and allowing each addition to absorb; continue for 20-25 minutes until rice is creamy and tender. Halfway through, pan-fry asparagus for 2 minutes, add a splash of water, cover and steam 3-5 minutes; remove. Cook prawns in the pan for 4-5 minutes until pink, opaque and cooked through; squeeze over lemon. Stir butter, grated hard cheese and most of the parsley into risotto. Top with prawns, asparagus and remaining parsley; serve with lemon wedges.

recipe_name: Teriyaki Salmon with Garlic Rice
cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 3 garlic cloves. Heat oven to 200 C. Grate garlic and stir it into a saucepan with rice and 300 ml water; bring to boil, cover and cook over low heat for 10 minutes, then rest covered off heat for 10 minutes. Put salmon on a lined baking tray and roast for 10-15 minutes until opaque in the centre. Halve baby corn lengthways and cut broccoli into small florets. Stir-fry broccoli and corn in a non-stick pan for 2-3 minutes; add a splash of water, cover and steam for another 3-5 minutes until tender. Toss vegetables with half the sesame oil and half the sesame seeds and set aside. Warm teriyaki sauce and remaining sesame oil in the pan for 1-2 minutes, then carefully turn cooked salmon in the glaze. Serve on fluffed garlic rice with vegetables and remaining sesame seeds.

recipe_name: Thai Pork and Mangetout Rice Bowls
cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 2 garlic cloves, 1 red chilli. Add rice and 300 ml water to a lidded saucepan; bring to boil, cover and cook over low heat for 10 minutes, then rest covered off heat for 10 minutes. Chop onion and chilli, grate garlic and halve mangetout. Stir-fry mangetout in a hot non-stick pan for 2-3 minutes until tender; transfer to a plate. Add pork mince to the pan and brown for 5-6 minutes, breaking it up until fully cooked; drain excess fat. Add onion, garlic and chilli and cook for 2-3 minutes until fragrant. Return mangetout, stir in ketjap manis and soy sauce and heat until piping hot, loosening with water if needed. Fluff rice and serve topped with pork stir-fry.

recipe_name: Coconut Lentil and Spinach Curry with Naan
cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 2 garlic cloves. Slice onion, grate garlic, dice tomatoes, drain and rinse lentils, and zest and halve lime. Soften onion in a saucepan over medium heat with a splash of water for 5-6 minutes. Stir in garam masala, garlic and lime zest for 1 minute. Add coconut milk, drained lentils, half a vegetable stock cube and about 150 ml water; bring to boil, then simmer 6-8 minutes. Add diced tomatoes and spinach and cook 1-2 minutes until spinach wilts. Warm naan in a toaster or oven for 2-3 minutes. Stir mango chutney and lime juice into curry, adjust thickness with water and serve with warm naan.

recipe_name: Turkey and Feta Burgers with Chips
cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 0.5 lettuce. Heat oven to 200 C. Cut potatoes into thin chips, toss with vegetable oil and spread on a baking tray; roast for 25-30 minutes, turning halfway, until golden. Crumble feta into turkey mince and mix thoroughly; divide into two patties. Heat a non-stick frying pan over medium heat and cook patties for about 5-7 minutes per side until completely cooked through and the centre reaches 74 C. Rest for 2 minutes. Halve and toast burger buns cut-side down in the pan for about 1 minute. Slice tomatoes and shred lettuce. Fill buns with turkey-feta patties, lettuce and tomato, and serve with chips.

recipe_name: Cheesy Beef Tacos with Tomato Salsa
cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 0.5 lettuce. Heat oven to 220 C (200 C fan). Cut potatoes into wedges and spread on a lined tray; roast for 30-35 minutes, turning halfway. Dice tomatoes and toss with lime juice to make salsa; shred lettuce. Heat a large non-stick frying pan and brown beef mince for 5-7 minutes, breaking it up until cooked through. Stir in cumin, smoked paprika and tomato puree for 1 minute. Crumble in half the beef stock cube with 100 ml water; simmer for 3-4 minutes until thick. Warm tortillas according to packet instructions. Fill with beef, cheddar, lettuce and tomato-lime salsa; serve with wedges.

recipe_name: Chicken Pesto Mozzarella Pasta Salad
cooking_instructions: Bring a pan of water to the boil and cook pasta according to packet instructions. Drain, rinse briefly under cold water and leave to cool. Slice chicken into strips and heat olive oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook chicken for 7-10 minutes, turning, until cooked through, then set aside to cool slightly. Halve cherry tomatoes, tear mozzarella and roughly chop rocket. Toss pasta with pesto, tomatoes, mozzarella, rocket and chicken. Scatter pumpkin seeds over just before serving.

recipe_name: Sausage Apple and Root Veg Traybake
cooking_instructions: Heat oven to 220 C (200 C fan). Cut potatoes and carrots into bite-sized chunks, red onion into wedges and apple into thick slices, removing the core. Toss potatoes, carrots and onion with vegetable oil on a large tray and roast for 15 minutes. Add sausages and apple, turn everything and roast for another 20-25 minutes until vegetables are tender and sausages are fully cooked through. Dissolve half a beef stock cube in 150 ml boiling water. Transfer tray juices to a small saucepan, add stock and simmer for 3-5 minutes to make a light gravy. Serve over sausages and roasted vegetables.

recipe_name: Pork Meatballs with Creamy Chive Sauce
cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 2 garlic cloves. Heat oven to 220 C (200 C fan). Cut potatoes into 1 cm chips, spread on a lined tray and roast for 25-30 minutes, turning halfway. Grate garlic. Mix breadcrumbs with 2 tbsp water, pork mince and half the garlic, then shape into 10 meatballs. Place on a second tray and roast for 12-15 minutes until cooked through, adding to oven halfway through the chips. Trim green beans and boil for 3-5 minutes until tender. For the sauce, warm remaining garlic in a non-stick pan for 30 seconds, add creme fraiche, half a chicken stock cube and 75 ml water; simmer 1-2 minutes until slightly thickened. Stir in most chives, then the cooked meatballs. Serve with chips, beans and remaining chives.

recipe_name: Falafel Salad Wraps with Harissa Mayo
cooking_instructions: Heat oven to 220 C (200 C fan). Cut potatoes into wedges, toss with vegetable oil and roast for 25-30 minutes, turning halfway. Place ready-made falafel on another tray and bake according to packet instructions until piping hot. Grate carrot and dice tomatoes. Mix harissa paste with mayonnaise, adding a teaspoon of water if needed for a spreadable sauce. Warm tortillas for 1-2 minutes in a dry pan. Fill with falafel, carrot, tomatoes and harissa mayonnaise; serve with wedges.

recipe_name: Chicken Satay with Cucumber and Jasmine Rice
cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 2 garlic cloves. Rinse jasmine rice and put in a lidded saucepan with 300 ml water. Bring to the boil, cover and cook on low for 10-12 minutes, then rest off heat for 10 minutes. Slice cucumber into thin half-moons and squeeze over half the lime juice. Chop chicken into bite-sized pieces and grate garlic. Fry chicken in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat for 7-10 minutes until fully cooked; add garlic for the final minute. Mix peanut butter, soy sauce, remaining lime juice and 120 ml hot water until smooth. Pour into the pan, simmer 2-4 minutes until glossy and coating the chicken, thinning with water if needed. Serve over rice with cucumber and crushed peanuts.

recipe_name: Lamb Burgers with Harissa and Rocket
cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 2 garlic cloves. Heat oven to 220 C (200 C fan). Cut potatoes into chips and roast on a lined tray for 25-30 minutes, turning halfway. Mix lamb mince with breadcrumbs and grated garlic; shape into two burger patties. Slice red onion and fry in a non-stick pan with a splash of water for 5-6 minutes until softened. Stir harissa into onions and set aside. Cook lamb patties in the same pan for about 5-6 minutes per side until cooked through. Slice tomatoes and crumble feta. Toast burger buns, then fill with rocket, lamb patties, harissa onions, tomatoes and feta. Serve with chips.

recipe_name: Teriyaki Salmon Tacos with Sweet Potato
cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 0.5 lettuce. Heat oven to 220 C (200 C fan). Cut sweet potatoes into wedges, spread on a lined tray and roast for 25-30 minutes, turning halfway. Mix soy sauce with honey. Pan-fry salmon over medium heat for 4-5 minutes on the first side and 3-4 minutes on the other, until cooked through. Pour in soy-honey mixture and turn salmon briefly until coated; remove from heat and flake into large pieces. Mix sesame seeds into mayonnaise. Warm tortillas in a dry pan for about 30 seconds per side. Fill with shredded lettuce, salmon and sesame mayonnaise; serve with sweet potato wedges.

recipe_name: Mushroom Bacon and Pea Risotto
cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 1 garlic clove. Dissolve vegetable stock cube in 750 ml hot water. Slice leek and mushrooms, grate garlic and dice bacon lardons if large. Fry bacon in a wide pan for 5-7 minutes until browned and cooked through; remove. Add mushrooms and fry for 4-5 minutes until golden, then add leek and cook for 3-4 minutes. Stir in garlic and arborio rice for 1 minute. Add hot stock one ladle at a time, stirring regularly and waiting until mostly absorbed; continue for 20-25 minutes until rice is creamy and tender. Add peas for the last 4 minutes. Stir in bacon, butter and grated hard cheese; let stand 2 minutes before serving.

recipe_name: Sausage and Gnocchi Broccoli Traybake
cooking_instructions: Heat oven to 200 C (180 C fan). Cut broccoli into small florets, red onion into wedges and cherry tomatoes in half. Place sausages, gnocchi and onion on a large baking tray, toss with vegetable oil and dried oregano, and roast for 15 minutes. Add broccoli, tomatoes and balsamic vinegar; toss gently and roast for another 12-15 minutes until vegetables are tender, gnocchi is golden and sausages are cooked through. Rest for 2 minutes, mix the tray juices through the gnocchi and divide between plates.
